note: The Institute's evidence manifest. Each entry is one feed: where it comes from, how it travels, and when it last moved. The nightly refresh (.github/workflows/refresh.yml) reads this file, pulls what it can over the open internet of a CI runner, and commits only when something changed. A copy is published to apps/platform/public/data/sources.json as the provenance record behind every figure on the site.

sources.name: Key stage 4 performance (Attainment 8, EBacc, basics)
sources.cadence: Provisional mid-October, revised February, final spring
sources.notes: School-level release is a zip download, not yet in the EES API. Pulled by hand via browser when a new vintage lands; next expected movement is the 2025/26 REVISED release, February 2027. Progress 8 has no 2024/25 or 2025/26 cohort; the last published P8 is 2023/24.

sources.name: Pupil attendance in schools (fortnightly)
sources.notes: National, regional and LA-level only — NOT school-level — so it feeds the pulse file (the national weather), never schools.json. apiDataSetId is resolved at run time from the catalogue entry by pull-attendance.mjs.

sources.name: Get Information About Schools (the register itself)
sources.notes: The canonical registry: every school's URN, status, opens, closures and successor URNs. The refresh uses it to catch converted academies (URN changes) and newly opened schools before a performance release names them.

sources.name: School workforce in England (teachers, ratios, vacancies, absence)
sources.cadence: Annual, from the November census (published the following June)
sources.lastVersion: 2025 release (Nov 2025 census; turnover and sickness to 2024/25)
sources.notes: School-level CSVs inside the release zip: size of workforce, pupil-teacher ratios, vacancies, sickness absence. Pulled by hand via browser; the tripwire watches for an API id.

sources.name: School finance: CFR (maintained) and AAR (academies) benchmarking returns
sources.cadence: Annual; CFR published summer, AAR the following spring (matched pair lags a year)
sources.lastVersion: 2024-25 financial year (CFR Full Data Workbook + AAR download)
sources.notes: Two per-school workbooks behind the DfE benchmarking tool: consistent financial reporting for LA-maintained schools, academies' accounting returns for trusts. Only full-year (12-month) returns are merged; part-year returns from mid-year trust moves are set aside so per-pupil figures stay honest. AAR figures are rounded to £1,000s at source.

sources.name: Special educational needs in England (EHC plans, SEN support, units and resourced provision)
sources.cadence: Annual, from the January census (published the following June)
sources.notes: The release's school-level underlying data file: pupils with an EHC plan and on SEN support, primary need by school, SEN unit and resourced provision flags. The same file carries each school's parliamentary constituency (2024 boundaries), which feeds the pcon scope. Pulled by hand via browser.

sources.name: Early years: EYFSP results and the phonics screening check
sources.cadence: Annual, each October (EYFSP and phonics publish separately)
sources.notes: Authority level by necessity: the DfE publishes no school-level EYFSP or phonics. Holds GLD, average ELGs, all-ELG expected and phonics Y1/end-of-Y2 for every LA and region (latest plus previous year) and the national trend. Phonics catalogue: explore-education-statistics.service.gov.uk/find-statistics/phonics-screening-check-attainment.

sources.name: Ofsted inspection outcomes (management information)
sources.lastVersion: latest inspections as at 30 Sep 2026 (report cards + legacy judgements)
sources.notes: The monthly 'latest inspections' CSV now carries the renewed framework's report cards (per-area five-point grades, safeguarding, category of concern) alongside each school's last legacy judgement. Merged additively: the legacy base is kept, report cards ride on top as rc. Hand pull, monthly.

sources.name: Key stage 2 attainment by school
sources.notes: The December 2026 release is the tripwire: when the API dataset version moves, the refresh flags it in the run summary so primary-phase Atlas can be built on fresh data.

sources.name: School census: pupils by national curriculum year group, per school
sources.cadence: Annual (January census, published June); 2015/16 to 2025/26 held
sources.notes: 2019/20 to 2025/26 from the EES release all-files zips (spc_school_level_underlying_data*); 2015/16 to 2018/19 from gov.uk SFR underlying-data zips (Schools_NCYear_UD / pupil_characteristics_UD). URN changes at academisation stitched by LAESTAB continuity; GIAS links unavailable from the build environment.

sources.name: Suspensions and permanent exclusions, per school, full-year series
sources.cadence: Annual (full year published each July); exc_school.csv carries 2006/07 to 2024/25, 2015/16 onwards used
sources.notes: trust_name per school per year from the same file gives trust membership windows; suppressed cells (x, z) stored as -1 and left out of rates.

sources.name: 16 to 18 performance tables: A level and vocational results, L3 value added, A level subjects, per school and college
sources.cadence: Provisional in the autumn, final in the spring (2024/25 final published 23 April 2026; 2025/26 provisional expected late 2026)
sources.lastVersion: 2024/25 final (published 23 April 2026, updated 24 July 2026); subject tables 2023/24 and 2024/25
sources.notes: Institution-level files fetched with content.explore-education-statistics.service.gov.uk/api/data-set-files/{id}/download and built by data/pipeline/post16-build.py. Headline attainment 2021/22 to 2024/25; L3 value added (headline and subject) exists for 2023/24 and 2024/25 only, as the DfE did not publish it for cohorts with teacher-assessed GCSE baselines. Best three A levels and AAB are published for 2024/25 only in this release. Subject names are unified across years (e.g. Computer Studies/Computing = Computer Science).
